## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Separate fixtures, native desktop behavior, and live-provider observations. State what remains unverified.

## Review

- [ ] User data, unrelated provider configuration, and CLI history are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and changelog are updated.
- [ ] Screenshots/logs contain no credentials or private user content.
- [ ] UI/motion changes include representative evidence and focus/reduced-motion checks, or are not applicable.
